# zstd / decompress_cross_format

zstd's own fuzz target `decompress_cross_format` ([source](source/decompress_cross_format.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zstd (facebook/zstd at 82d322c4).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a differential check: One-shot: the same frame decoded as standard zstd1 (magic prepended) and as ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless must agree on acceptance in both directions, and when both accept, on decompressed size and bytes.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zstd at commit 82d322c4.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- One-shot: the same frame decoded as standard zstd1 (magic prepended) and as ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless must agree on acceptance in both directions, and when both accept, on decompressed size and bytes ([lines 58-86](source/decompress_cross_format.c#L58-L86)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- Streaming: the same comparison with one ZSTD_decompressStream call per format: both return 0 or neither; if both, out.pos equal and output bytes equal ([lines 88-119](source/decompress_cross_format.c#L88-L119)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
